en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim from his father, and Muhammad Bin Yahya from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, both together from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding four who had drunk (wine) so they were intoxicated. So they took weapons upon each other and fought. So two were killed and two were wounded.

So he<sup>asws</sup> ordered for the two injured ones, so each one of them were whipped eighty lashes, and judged with regards to the wergild of the two killed ones to be upon the two injured ones, and ordered that surgery be performed on the injuries, so it was reimbursed from the wergild. So if the two injured ones died, so there would be nothing upon anyone from the guardians of the two killed ones’.
